turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
Quick reminder: last weekend is finished. It is in the past.
Here is my thinking with one: "Last weekend I ___ (wash) my bike."
Step 1: Last weekend is finished time.
Step 2: wash is a normal verb.
Step 3: So I add -ed: "Last weekend I washed my bike."
Rule: for a finished action, put -ed on the end of most verbs.
Right: Yesterday she jumped into the pool. Wrong: Yesterday she jump into the pool.
Your turn. Write the past form of the verb in brackets:
"Last Sunday, my uncle ___ (fix) the car."
